items.question: What is DCPDC Sitecore AI?
items.answer: DCPDC Sitecore AI is a simple demo site showcasing component examples for Sitecore XM Cloud. It demonstrates modular UI patterns, layouts, and content-driven experiences built with Next.js App Router and the Content SDK. Ideal for exploring component variants and development best practices.

items.question: Who can buy from DCPDC Sitecore AI?
items.answer: DCPDC Sitecore AI works with skate brands and businesses. We focus on wholesale—contact us to discuss account setup, minimums, and product availability for your brand.

items.question: What does DCPDC Sitecore AI offer?
items.answer: We offer wholesale product basics including streetwear and core product lines. Check our Latest Streetwear and Latest Products sections on the site for current offerings and news.
